description: This source file defines the final class BlockNamespaceBehavior, which provides behavior to block messages directed toward entities within certain cached namespaces. It includes methods to instantiate the class and to check if a given message should be blocked based on namespace restrictions.

classes.name: BlockNamespaceBehavior
classes.description: A final class that provides behavior to block messages directed at entities in certain cached namespaces. It contains methods to create instances and to evaluate if a message should be blocked.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of BlockNamespaceBehavior with the provided BlockedNamespaces cache. Checks for null input.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Checks if the provided signal is directed at a namespace that is marked as blocked. Returns a completed future with the signal if not blocked, or a future that throws NamespaceBlockedException if it is.
